_readme: Scope template. Copy this file, edit it and generate the SoA with: python3 runner/soa.py --scope loot/<your-file>.json --out loot/soa.md
_mode: observational | active | lab | defensive. observational and defensive do NOT allow transmitting

site._jurisdiction: The SoA prints it in the header. It does not filter on it today: a human decides.

assessor._readme: THIS is what makes the same corpus produce a different SoA.
assessor._role: auditor | operator | regulator | manufacturer | defender. Recorded for the record, it grants nothing by itself
_mandates: system-ownership      = the system under test is yours
written-authorisation = written permission from its owner
credential-ownership  = the credential is yours (RFID: cloning someone else's is fraud)
spectrum-licence      = a licence or assignment in the band
regulatory-authority  = statutory power over the band (the regulator)
containment           = a cage or conducted path; the physical substitute for band permission

targets.label: Describe the asset
targets.authorization_ref: Reference to the contract or authorisation letter
targets._permitted_side_effects: actuates | persistent-state | dos. Granted by the OWNER of the equipment, not by the regulator. Empty = read-only.

spectrum._tx_modes: The ONLY authority over transmitting. Empty = nothing is transmitted. Values: interrogation | connection-oriented | pairing | injection | rogue-infrastructure | jamming
spectrum.tx_note: Say in one sentence what the client authorised and what it did not.

_excluded_controls: Leave it empty. Blocking is DERIVED from the corpus. An entry here is a human override and the report marks it as such.
